candidate.title: CytoSeq
candidate.scope: The middle row of the supplied Illumina single-cell poster crop: Gene expression cytometry (CytoSeq), with microwell loading, bead capture, bead pooling, cDNA synthesis/amplification and sequencing. CytoSeq and Gene expression cytometry are names for this target, not distinct workflow alternatives. The separately headed CLaP row above, Drop-Seq row below and partial Biotin-4-fluorescein chemical legend at the right are neighboring context with no depicted connection to CytoSeq. This record describes the schematic architecture, not a complete experimental implementation.

states.label: Cell suspension containing the mRNA target
features: Separate cells are depicted as the starting specimen.
The introductory single-cell icon identifies the biological target as RNA bearing an AA(A)n poly(A) tail; it is explanatory, not a separate extraction operation.

evidence.locator: CytoSeq row, Single cell / AA(A)n target icon and Cell suspension

states.label: Beads bearing unique barcoded capture oligonucleotides
features: Probe is drawn attached to a bead; its labeled segments run from the bead outward as Universal, Cell label, Molecular index, Oligo(dT).
Two differently colored decorated beads illustrate bead-specific oligos. The supplied primary abstract identifies cell- and molecular-barcoding capture probes.
No explicit 5-prime or 3-prime end labels or attachment chemistry are shown.

evidence.locator: CytoSeq row, bead-bound segmented oligo legend and Each bead with unique oligos
Abstract, opening two sentences (abstract-only evidence)
evidence.quote: We present a technically simple approach for gene expression cytometry combining next-generation sequencing with stochastic barcoding of single cells. A combinatorial library of beads bearing cell- and molecular-barcoding capture probes is used to uniquely label transcripts and reconstruct the digital gene expression profile of thousands of individual cells in a single experiment without the need for robotics or automation.

operations.information_effect: Creates the intended local association between a cell and the bead that will capture its mRNA; the icon does not establish actual occupancy or a guarantee against mixed-cell capture.

operations.label: Cell lysis, mRNAs hybridize on bead

operations.information_effect: Associates captured transcripts with probes carrying cell labels and molecular indices while cell/bead units remain separated in microwells. Hybridization is not itself represented as covalent transfer of a barcode to native RNA.

checks.rationale: All in-scope transformations are represented: joint cell/bead microwell loading, lysis and mRNA hybridization, pooling of RNA-bearing beads, the broad cDNA synthesis/amplification block, and sequencing. The only two-input operation is genuine joint cell/bead loading, and no separate branches are collapsed. Microwells persist through capture; beads are pooled before cDNA synthesis. The endpoint caption is retained with an explicit mRNA-derived cDNA interpretation. No unsupported end chemistry, internal library-preparation sequence, complete recovery or perfect cell attribution is claimed. Every supplied paper lead and the sole target method is assessed. At the declared schematic resolution, no consequential omission, unsupported assertion, paper/diagram conflict requiring correction, or blocking unknown remains.
